persistence: single canonical rebuildable semantic-index.json under a caller-selected index root
rules: Only canonical, hash-valid psc-knowledge-object/2 records are indexed.
The index contains derived metadata and may be deleted/rebuilt without changing semantic authority.
Query results are candidate object identities only and always require fresh SAVEF ValidUnder/certificate validation before reuse.
Exact semantic-identity/scope filters are domain-separated canonical artifact identities; byte differences are not silently normalized.
Index reads and writes are bounded; malformed, noncanonical, duplicate and resource-exhausted state fails closed.
